Awesome question! Getting that first shave just right is key to a fantastic experience! ✨ Since you're just starting out, here's a simple guide to using your new Dollar Shave Club goodies properly for the very first time:

Prep Your Skin: Start with a clean slate! Wash your face with warm water and a good face wash (like our Hydrating Face Wash) to remove dirt and oil. If you have it, a gentle exfoliant (Prep Scrub) can help lift hairs and prevent ingrowns.
